descriptions.w3d_k11b_checked_index_801f9fbc: Appears to validate an index against a pointer vector length: selector modes 2 and 3 take the caller index, modes 0 and 1 select none, other modes fail; returns -1 when out of range.
descriptions.w3d_k11b_reverse_bits_8021d7b0: Mirrors the low count bits of a value so bit i of the input becomes bit count-1-i of the result; the first argument is unused.
